schemes.official_name: Projektstudium / Project Studies (TUM School of Management; company-proposed projects)
schemes.english_name: Project Studies, TUM School of Management
schemes.description: Teams of 2-5 students carry out a research or practical project proposed by a company and supervised by a TUM chair; kick-off, mid-term meeting, final presentation and written report; 3 months full-time or 6 months part-time. Companies submit topics via a chair or the student council job board; students apply individually or as a team. Entrepreneurship Research Institute publishes dated company project studies (Oct 2026) and IDPs with business partners. Compulsory module in the Bachelor Management and Technology (12 ECTS); optional or compulsory in master's programmes. Note: the compulsory module itself can also be satisfied with research projects, so this record covers the company-proposed route only.

profile_md: TUM's verified employer-linked team provision is distributed across schools rather than institution-wide. In the School of Management, Project Studies place teams of 2-5 students on topics proposed by companies, supervised by a chair, ending in a written report and presentation (3 months full-time); the module is compulsory in the Bachelor Management and Technology and compulsory or optional in master's programmes, and the Entrepreneurship Research Institute lists company project studies dated October 2026 (StudySmarter, KlaroCare, Beautechful). In computing, the iPraktikum (10 ECTS) gives each of 8-12 partner companies per semester its own student team to build an iOS app (Summer 2026 partners include BMW, eBay, Siemens). Centrally, the Project Weeks framework (2-6 ECTS, open across Schools, 11-15 January 2027) did not show external organisations at framework level, so it is recorded as an umbrella only; the 1.000+ Project Week places master's teams of up to five in a medium-sized company for one week, but only the 2026 application announcement was found. Mechanical engineering team projects are individual assignments; natural-science, social-science and life-science searches found no team client projects; architecture studios with real clients remain unverified. Further chair-level industry courses are likely. Source pages were English and German; German extracts are search summaries or translated fetch summaries.
gaps: Reduced-depth review. Project Weeks individual courses untested (fetch truncated). 1.000+ delivery unconfirmed. globalDrive and architecture studio client projects unverified. Project Studies team and company details come from undated guidelines plus search summaries; fetch results are tool summaries, not full page text. iPraktikum compulsory/elective status unknown. Further departmental and chair-level industry projects likely exist.
